messages:
olivia: hey team — quick week1 check-in (doing async):
- done: forked + cloned monorepo, ran `yarn install` (a couple warnings but succeeded), opened a tiny README PR (link in my profile). set up github access & 2fa.
- blockers: 1) I don't have access to the internal runbooks (Confluence 'redwood-runbooks' shows permission denied). 2) can't SSH to the dedicated GPU test instance `dedicated-test-gpu-1`: `Permission denied (publickey)`. I added my SSH key to my profile but still blocked.
- today: need runbook access so I can follow the GPU bootstrapping steps, and one of you to confirm the SSH group membership or point me to the right infra contact. Happy to pair for 30m if that's easier. :wave:

alex: hey olivia — welcome! :tada: for the runbooks, we usually add people to the 'eng-oncall' Confluence group. pinged @maria to add you. for SSH, are you using the new key format? try `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood olivia@dedicated-test-gpu-1.internal` — also check `ssh -v` output and paste the last few lines here if it fails.

olivia: thanks alex. `ssh -v` shows:
```
debug1: Authentications that can continue: publickey
debug1: Offering public key: /home/olivia/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood
debug1: Server accepts key: pkalg ssh-rsa blen 279
debug1: sign_and_send_pubkey: signing failed: agent refused operation
Permission denied (publickey).
```
Not sure what "agent refused operation" means — my ssh-agent is running and I added with `ssh-add`.

maria: adding you now, olivia. also cc'ing infra (jamal) on SSH. re: Confluence: you should get an invite within a few minutes. if it doesn't arrive, LMK and i'll escalate.

jamal: olivia — can you confirm your IAM identity ID? i can check the VM metadata. alternatively, i can just add your email to the instance's allowed SSH group. quick fix: i've added `olivia@redwood.com` to `infra-ssh-access` and restarted the instance's OS login agent. give it a minute and try again.

olivia: retrying now... same `agent refused operation` error but different debug lines:
```
debug1: PKCS11 provider 'ssh-pkcs11' returned error
debug1: sign_and_send_pubkey: hostkey sign failed: provider failed
```
I don't think I'm using a hardware token — how can i check?

jamal: that explains it — looks like your SSH agent tried a PKCS11 provider first (we've seen this with macOS + some YubiKey setups). run `ssh-add -l` to see identities. if you see a PKCS11 entry or nothing, try `ssh -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood olivia@dedicated-test-gpu-1.internal`. i'm also adding an ACL rule so `IdentitiesOnly` isn't required long-term for the test VM.

olivia: ok `ssh-add -l` shows: `The agent has no identities.` i re-added with `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood` and now `ssh-add -l` lists the key. `ssh -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood olivia@dedicated-test-gpu-1.internal` connected! running a quick smoke script `./scripts/run_gpu_smoke.sh` now.

maria: great — i'll follow up in the onboarding checklist and mark SSH + runbook access as done. olivia, if you want the GPU quota increase for longer runs ping me and i'll open the ticket.

onboarding-bot: welcome message: "Welcome olivia! Your Confluence membership was added and SSH access was granted to `dedicated-test-gpu-1` — see /onboarding/checklist for next steps." :robot_face:

olivia: thanks everyone — resolved for now. next on my list: run the smoke tests, then try the example inference endpoint locally and open a small end-to-end PR. i'll post another quick async update after that. :sparkles:
